title: onboard hypatia-30b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
body:
Summary: Onboard Hypatia-30B v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds model metadata (manifest and tags), generates performance profiles for CPU/GPU variants, and wires the new model into the changelog/release-notes automation pipeline so model release notes are surfaced automatically in the release dashboard.

Motivation: Hypatia-30B is an open decoder-only model that provides a good latency/quality tradeoff for long-context workloads. Product requested availability for dedicated and hosted tiers (PM-987). To enable safe rollout we need metadata, vetted perf profiles, and automated changelog entries for auditing and customer-facing release notes.

What changed:
- Add model manifest: models/hypatia/30b/v1.0/manifest.yaml (model id, architecture, tokenizer, quantization compatibility matrix, reference hashes).
- Add metadata: default aliases (hypatia-30b, hypatia-30b-v1), input-output schema hints, model tags (family:hypatia,size:30b,capabilities:completion,streaming).
- Performance profiles: perf-profiles/hypatia-30b/v1.0/ with CPU and GPU JSON profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs; includes throughput/latency SLOs and batching recommendations.
- Changelog automation: register new model in tools/changelog-generator/config.json so releasenotes workflow picks up model metadata and perf summary automatically.
- Small SDK compatibility update: examples/ and tests/ updated to reference new model alias.

Checklist: 
- [x] Manifest with content-addressed checksums
- [x] Perf profiles produced from benchmark-lab runs (GPU A100, T4; CPU 64-core)
- [x] Changelog generator integration and unit tests
- [x] SDK examples updated
- [x] Security review for model artifacts (no private data)

Testing:
- Unit tests for manifest schema and changelog generator added.
- End-to-end bench runs executed in benchmark-lab; aggregated profiles attached as JSON.
- Local smoke test of SDK examples verified streaming + embedding endpoints against staging.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main behind feature flag (model.enabled.hypatia-30b)
2) Canary on dedicated staging pool for a subset of tenants
3) Validate perf and error metrics for 48h; rollback if regressions > 10% on P95 latency
4) Promote to hosted catalog and update public release notes via changelog pipeline

Backward compatibility: New model aliases are additive; no breaking changes to existing API or model IDs. Changelog automation added with opt-in via config to avoid unexpected release note noise.

Notes on perf profiling: Perf runs were automated using benchmark-lab (see attached profile JSONs). We measured inference latencies across sequence lengths [128,512,2048] and reported both cold-start and warmed KV cache numbers. Batching recommendations were tuned to keep P95 under 200ms on A100 for seq=512 under the target throughput.

Related: ENG-4123 (onboarding process improvements), PM-987 (product request), SUP-2210 (customer pre-onboarding).
